title: Generic Cantor actions of Z wr Z are hyperfinite
strongest_verified_claim: For the countable discrete restricted wreath product W=Z wr Z, a dense G_delta in the full Polish Cantor action space has hyperfinite orbit equivalence relation on the entire Cantor space. More generally every Borel W-action on a standard Borel space admitting a Borel shift-equivariant map to the profinite integers has hyperfinite orbit relation on the whole domain, without freeness or surjectivity assumptions.
claims_checked: Exact Iyer–Shinko OWRQuestion3 and prior locally finite-asdim theorem boundary
Clopen finite-height obligations and countable compatible lifting in the full action topology
Exact Borel nonfree slab coordinates and proper extended metrics
Fixed-width finite Borel dimension and correct radius/width uniformities
Divisor metric compatibility and regular-piece orbit exhaustion via CJMST7.3
Entire integer-height preimage and explicit finite bounded-height pullback exhaustion
Stagewise gluing on invariant Borel pieces
scope_limits: Generic in the full action space, not a pointwise comeager/conull restriction.
The general Borel theorem requires the profinite-height factor; not a result for all Borel W-actions.
No freeness, minimality, invariant measure, or surjectivity is assumed in the Borel theorem.
Finite slab dimensions may grow with width; slab components need not be finite.
No comeager conjugacy class, finite-order action, global integer-height factor or uniform measurable choice across actions is claimed.
